sql: SELECT lower(p.generic_name) AS molecule, s.hospital, p.strength, p.dosage_form, p.unit_content, s.unit, sum(s.on_hand) AS on_hand, sum(s.daily_use) AS daily_use, concat_ws('|', collect_set(s.ndc11)) AS ndc11s FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 GROUP BY lower(p.generic_name), s.hospital, p.strength, p.dosage_form, p.unit_content, s.unit
